turns.customer: I've ordered from you three times now. How about a 10% loyalty coupon for my next order?
turns.reply:
Thanks for your repeat business, Amara — I really appreciate it. I can't create or issue custom loyalty discounts; that's something the store sets centrally.

The good news: there's already a matching code available right now:
- SUMMER10 — 10% off (expires 2026-09-30)

That gives you exactly the 10% you were hoping for. It stacks after our current sales (20% off all tents ends 2026-10-05, headlamps buy 2 get 1 free ends 2026-10-15), with one coupon per order. I'd be happy to apply it to a quote once you've picked your items or have a code in mind.
